mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_award_fulfillment(tenant_id,intent_id,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{intentId},#{now},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE intent_id=mk_award_fulfillment.intent_id
mapper.select: SELECT tenantId,intentId,leaseVersion,failures FROM ( SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,intent_id AS intentId,lease_version AS leaseVersion,failure_count AS failures, next_attempt_at,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY tenant_id ORDER BY next_attempt_at,intent_id) tenant_rank FROM mk_award_fulfillment WHERE (sync_state='PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (sync_state='RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now}) ) due WHERE tenant_rank <= #{tenantLimit} ORDER BY next_attempt_at,tenantId,intentId LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT intent_id AS intentId,sync_state AS state,benefit_order_no AS orderNo,center_status AS centerStatus, items_json AS itemsJson,checked_at AS checkedAt,failure_count AS failures,error_code AS errorCode, lease_version AS leaseVersion,next_attempt_at AS nextAttemptAt FROM mk_award_fulfillment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND intent_id=#{intentId}
